purpose: Teach: クイーン/神戸大学/日本テレビ/ヤマハ/セルビア/養老/慶應義塾/中国共産党

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがクイーンの曲を聴かせて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to play us a Queen song.
lines.style: Warm, gentle conversational opening. Slight upward inflection on his name, like sharing something she knows will delight him. Calm, assured pace. The tone of someone sharing good news carefully.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが神戸大学のお話して下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me about Kobe University.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick rhythm, words tumbling slightly over each other in excitement. Eyes wide. The urgency of a child who can't wait to share what he just learned.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが日本テレビの取材を受けられたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was interviewed by Nittele.
lines.style: Softly proud, as if she's noticing something admirable about his father. Measured pace. A slight pause before the news itself—like she's letting him prepare for something interesting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ヤマハのピアノで練習したいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to practice on a Yamaha piano.
lines.style: Focused desire in his voice. Direct statement, no hedging. Quiet but firm—this matters to him. A small intake of breath before the request, like he's gathering his courage.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがセルビア駐在のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me he's been posted to Serbia.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly more formal register. Deliberate pacing. There's a quietness here—sharing information that's significant, treating it as something worth sitting with for a moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと養老の滝行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to Yoro Falls with Dad.
lines.style: Yearning undertone. Soft but insistent. The 'want' carries longing, not demand. A child naming something precious he's noticed matters to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが慶應義塾のOB会に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad went to his Keio alumni gathering.
lines.style: Even, observational tone. Not particularly animated—just relaying information as though it's one more small thing his father does. Steady delivery, no emphasis.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと中国共産党のお話、難しいけど聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad was talking about the Communist Party of China, and I listened even though it was hard to understand.
lines.style: Quieter, more thoughtful than his earlier eagerness. Pride in the effort of listening even when lost. Slower pace—processing as he speaks. A small note of vulnerability on 'hard to understand,' softened by his commitment to try.
